text: maya (Design): Quick heads-up — experimenting with a compact left nav that groups 'Models' + 'Deployments' under a single cluster. Thinking about the cluster label: 'Workloads' vs 'Workspaces'. Opinions? sam (Frontend): 'Workloads' sounds more technical; 'Workspaces' is friendlier. Either works, but breadcrumbs must match exactly: breadcrumb -> Workloads / Models / . jonah (PM): Also need clarity on canonical deep link shapes. Two proposals: `/w/:orgId/workloads/:clusterType/:itemId` or `/workspace/:id/model/:modelId`. Which is cleaner for our router? sam (Frontend): Prefer `/workspace/:id/model/:modelId` — simpler to integrate into current route map. Fallback rules: if `:modelId` absent show list; if `:workspaceId` invalid redirect to `/workspace` with a toast. kevin (A11y): Accessibility nit: breadcrumbs need proper landmarks and `aria-current` on the last crumb. When we collapse groups, ensure the skiplink target points to first interactive element inside the nav pane. Also prefer skiplink copy: "Skip to main navigation" over "Skip nav". maya (Design): Good point. Copy tweak: currently we show a `+` for collapsed groups. Could we try a chevron-only with an accessible label, e.g., `Workloads ▸` and tooltip "Expand" on hover? Less ambiguous than `+`. sam (Frontend): We'll ensure a 44px tap target on mobile by making the full row clickable. Use `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`: ``. jonah (PM): Shareable links requirement from support: permalink should preserve UI state when needed. Put `view=compact` as an optional query param, e.g., `/workspace/123/model/xyz?view=compact`. Avoid relying on global cookies for link behavior. kevin (A11y): If toggling view via query param, announce the change with `aria-live=\"polite\"`: e.g., a region that says "Navigation collapsed" so SR users aren't disoriented. maya (Design): Breadcrumb truncation question: on narrow widths, should we ellipsize with a title attribute or provide the full name in an accessible label? sam (Frontend): Use visual truncation + `aria-label` containing full name. Tooltips (`title`) are unreliable on touch. Example: `Very Long W... `. jonah (PM): Avoid relying solely on `title` for keyboard users. Add a visually-hidden full copy inside the crumb popover for discoverability. kevin (A11y): Keyboard focus order after clicking a breadcrumb should land on the main content header. Use `element.focus()` responsibly; ensure the header is focusable (tabindex=-1) so focus lands predictably. maya (Design): Layout debate: icons-only compact nav vs icons + micro-label. Icons-only is denser; icons+label better for discoverability. Quick poll: :thumbsup: = icons-only, :raising_hand: = icons+mini-label. jonah (PM): I'll run a small hallway test tomorrow. For development, let's keep both modes toggleable via local storage and query param override so we can demo them. sam (Frontend): Add `?navMode=compact` as an override. Router should normalize routes (no duplicate slashes) and preserve `view` and `navMode`. We'll add fallback matchers in the route layer. maya (Design): Copy detail: breadcrumb separator is `›` currently. Make separators `aria-hidden=true` so SRs don't read them; consider a thinner glyph for visual subtlety. kevin (A11y): Confirmed: set `aria-hidden=\"true\"` on separators and ensure the crumb links include `aria-current` when active. Also check breadcrumb color contrast — the medium grey might fail AA on some displays. navbot (deploy-bot): note: branch `nav-compact-experiments` deployed to staging at `staging.redwood.internal/nav-test` (build 2026.03.22-9). maya (Design): Can folks try staging and drop reactions? Task list: 1) validate skiplink target, 2) check aria-live messages, 3) confirm breadcrumb contrast, 4) test permalink behavior. sam (Frontend): Will test and post fixes here. jonah (PM): I'll collect feedback after the hallway test and decide on the final label. kevin (A11y): I'll run a screen reader pass and upload notes. Checklist: keyboard nav, focus order, aria-labels on truncated crumbs, aria-live for mode changes. maya (Design): If no objections by EOD Friday, we'll ship the compact grouping with the label "Workloads" and the a11y improvements above. :sparkles: sam (Frontend): :thumbsup: jonah (PM): :thumbsup: (reaction)
